title: The Plant You Can Watch Grow
hook: Some bamboo grows a meter a day, so fast you can watch it.
script: Some bamboo grows a meter a day, so fast you can watch it. That makes it the fastest growing plant on the planet, and it is not even a tree. Bamboo is a giant grass, closer to your lawn than to an oak. So how does a plant climb that fast? Its stalk is built from segments that all stretch at once, like a telescope. It borrows stored energy from a huge web of roots underground. What happens to a bamboo forest when it finally flowers? Many kinds flower once in a century, and then every plant dies together.
